async def act(page):
    # Navigate to the homepage to escape the 404 page
    await page.goto('/')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # On the homepage, look for a user menu button or profile link
    # Use a specific selector based on typical GitLab UI; adjust if needed
    await page.get_by_role('link', name='Profile').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # On the profile page, set the status to 'Busy'
    await page.get_by_role('combobox', name='Status').select_option('Busy')
    # Save changes
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Save changes').click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait for confirmation
